body:
From rules you approved (pfu-2):
- When you sleep, your pet walks over and naps near you (rules-mech-sleep). Uses the pet sleep moves.
- Visiting friends can pet and play with your pet, no feeding (rules-mech-friend-care). Your pet reacts the same way it reacts to you.
Picture made. You nap on a blanket here; the real sleep spot comes from the game.
- Friends see the real move too (Plan, 31 Oct).
Stage: 2, pet brain.

comments.text:
Done: pet naps beside you; a friend pets it and plays ball.
Friends see the real move now. Limit: no elbow, so the hand can't reach the floor.

short: Pet naps beside you; friends pet and play. OK?
title: Pets nap near you; greet friends
